objective.raw: Ground MALACHII Sovereign Website Factory in current authoritative website standards.
objective.normalized: Establish current authoritative accessibility, performance, search, and application-security baselines for Skill 002.
success_criteria: Core Web Vitals targets established from web.dev
Google Search baseline established from Search Central
Verification-oriented web security baseline established from OWASP

claims.claim: WCAG 2.2 is a W3C Recommendation and is the appropriate default accessibility baseline for this Skill, with MALACHII targeting Level AA for ordinary public production websites unless stricter requirements apply.
claims.rationale: The current W3C Recommendation defines WCAG 2.2; the AA target is MALACHII policy layered on that standard.

claims.claim: Current Core Web Vitals good-experience thresholds are LCP <= 2.5 seconds, INP <= 200 milliseconds, and CLS <= 0.1, evaluated at the 75th percentile for most users.
claims.rationale: The current web.dev Web Vitals documentation states these thresholds and the 75th-percentile evaluation guidance.

claims.claim: Google Search Essentials currently organizes search eligibility guidance around technical requirements, spam policies, and key best practices, while explicitly not guaranteeing indexing or ranking.
claims.rationale: The current official Google Search Essentials page defines these categories and caveat.

claims.claim: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 is the latest stable ASVS release and is designed as a verifiable application-security standard; OWASP Top 10:2025 is an awareness baseline rather than comprehensive verification coverage.
claims.rationale: OWASP identifies ASVS 5.0.0 as the latest stable ASVS and recommends ASVS when a verification standard is needed, while the Top 10 project describes itself as an awareness document.

limitations: Standards and platform guidance may evolve; refresh evidence when a future build depends on current requirements.
These standards define baselines and targets; satisfying a structural validator does not establish complete compliance or production performance.

deliverable.summary: Skill 002 is grounded in current W3C accessibility, Google performance/search, and OWASP verification guidance.
recommendations: Re-run live research when standards freshness materially affects a future website build.
